limitations: The exact results concern scalar common-minimizer quadratics and unconstrained population feedback minimizers. Candidate-set clipping and the hypergradient null step can prevent unstable raw proposals from being applied; the analysis is not a general convergence or divergence theorem for SOSGM.
provenance: Source-specific analysis of the out-of-sample ratio and hypergradient feedbacks introduced for stochastic online scaled gradient methods in arXiv:2609.11751v2, specialized to positive scalar random-curvature common-minimizer quadratics and compared with the exact one-step mean-square SGD objective.
record_title: Population feedback targets and sharp curvature-stability thresholds in stochastic OSGM
